newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian Air to drop surcharge, raise rates.
newsitem.headline: Canadian Air to drop surcharge, raise rates.

text.p: Canadian Airlines International said is dropping its international cargo fuel surcharge immediately, and raising cargo rates 3-5 percent on June 1.
CAI's international rates will rise five percent June 1, the airline said.
CAI will retain its domestic fuel surcharge until June 1, then raise domestic cargo rates by 3 percent.
Canadian joins a long list of airlines dropping or modifying cargo fuel surcharges put in place last November and December to cope with a spike in global jet fuel prices.
Calgary-based CAI said in a statement that "while fuel prices may have declined from their recent peaks they have not returned to normal seasonal levels."
Other costs continue to escalate, necessitating rate increases, CAI said. -Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
